description: Runs a deterministic projection plus Monte Carlo simulation of a retirement savings plan, aggregating active pension streams before applying personal income tax allowances and the shared GESY ceiling. Use for a retirement savings sustainability or portfolio-longevity projection. Reuse the user's ages, savings, contributions and planned monthly spending; ask for each missing essential input and never use example personal values. Values are EUR, contributions/drawdown are monthly, and ages are years. Supply pensionStreams to include Cyprus or foreign pension income; concurrent streams are aggregated before applying the personal progressive allowance, one foreign-pension allowance and the shared €180,000 GESY ceiling. Foreign pensions use the 2026 flat 5% rate above €5,000 unless a net override is supplied. Omitted state pension means pension income is excluded. Returns, inflation, horizon and simulation count use disclosed modelling assumptions when omitted. Runs without seed are stochastic; a supplied seed makes identical inputs repeatable for the same implementation version.

currentSavings.description: Current investable savings balance in EUR.

expectedAnnualReturn.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default.

expectedAnnualReturnRetirement.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default.

inflationRate.description: Annual percentage value (e.g. 2.5 for 2.5%). Supply the actual rate unless the user accepts a stated modelling default.

monthlyContribution.description: Monthly contribution until retirement in EUR.

monthlyDrawdown.description: Planned monthly withdrawal in retirement in EUR.

pensionStreams.description: Optional annual pension streams that offset retirement drawdown. Concurrent streams are aggregated before applying progressive tax, the single 2026 foreign-pension €5,000 allowance, and the shared personal GESY ceiling. A supplied netAnnualOverride is treated as already net and is used as-is.

seed.description: Optional unsigned 32-bit seed for repeatable runs with identical inputs and implementation versions. Omit to keep the run stochastic.

statePension.description: Expected monthly state pension in EUR.

name: run_retirement_stress_test
